title: Multica: Open-Source AI Agent Management Platform
summary: An open-source managed agents platform that integrates autonomous coding agents into human workflows as first-class teammates. It provides a vendor-neutral operating layer coordinating local daemons and cloud runtimes for agents like Claude Code, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot CLI.
research_notes: The project is named after the Multics operating system and aims to function as a Human-AI Operating System for collaborative software development.

evolution.summary: Evolved from a macOS desktop client into a full-stack platform featuring a 'Squads' system for multi-agent collaboration and a standardized Agent Client Protocol (ACP). Recently added a skills framework for packaging agent patterns and a template catalog for one-click deployment.
